text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Good morning. I went bowling
during the time off you gave me.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Right down the middle of the lane in a straight line.
Consistently, without deviating a fraction of an inch.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Single-mindedly, she kept throwing
without even caring about the score."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
This is it. This is what a proper day off looks like.
You're welcome to take notes, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Calstone Light O
spent a day off that was far too straightforward.
